parent.primary_reference: Akshay et al., Proof Systems for QBF Synthesis: Extracting Skolem and Herbrand Functions, SAT 2026, DOI 10.4230/LIPIcs.SAT.2026.3

source_model.synqbf_proof_object: A circuit phi_hat over xi and xhat_i satisfying SynQBF Definition 4.3.
relevant_published_facts: Condition 1 identifies the original matrix after substituting xhat_i = NOT xi.
Condition 2 requires a quantifier-dependent representability equivalence for every variable.
Conditions 1 and 2 are propositional equivalences; the paper notes they are checkable in coNP.
The paper notes a Cook-Reckhow extension could attach propositional proofs of these equivalences, but does not build that extension in the presented system.
Game-value circuits at every prefix position are obtainable from a SynQBF proof by restriction.
Skolem/Herbrand functions are obtainable by restriction of the same proof circuit.
SynQBF proof size is polynomially related to total game-value circuit size.
Any QBF proof system with polynomial-time extraction of Skolem and Herbrand circuits is p-simulated by SynQBF.

scoped_prefix.purpose: Match the existing V1.1 local Boolean-functional-synthesis interface.

domain_representation.map: For a SynQBF proof of forall B exists X . F, restrict the proof circuit to the game-value circuit immediately after all B moves. The remaining suffix is existential, so this game value is exactly D(B)=exists X F(B,X).
domain_representation.v1_1_representation: Translate that Boolean circuit gate-by-gate using the frozen V1.1 circuit-equivalence lemma.

witness_representation.map: Use the published SynQBF restriction for each existential variable to extract its Skolem circuit, then translate the circuit to V1.1 DAG form.

extraction_time.caveat: This concerns obtaining Boolean DAG representations only, not local V1.1 proof certificates.

unresolved_certificate_axis.target: Construct (pi_D, pi_f) accepted by the frozen V1.1 local checker from a SynQBF proof without invoking generic propositional equivalence/tautology validity.
unresolved_certificate_axis.exact_obstruction: SynQBF Definition 4.3 conditions (1) and (2) are semantic propositional equivalences. Treating those equivalences as already-valid atoms inside V1.1 would violate the generic-validity firewall unless an explicit locally replayable proof translation is supplied.
acceptable_routes: Restrict to a SynQBF fragment where each representability equivalence has a syntactic/local certificate replayable by frozen V1.1 rules.
Attach an explicit propositional proof object and give a polynomial local translation of that proof system into frozen V1.1 certificates.
Prove a direct structural translation for a nontrivial SynQBF fragment using only CONST, AFFINE_XOR, EXISTING_DAG_NODE, GUARDED_ITE, INTERNAL_COVER_WITNESS and already-frozen local justifications.

reverse_direction_no_redundant_work.theorem_4_14_barrier: Do not manually build a general V1.1-to-SynQBF proof translation before checking whether V1.1 qualifies as a QBF proof system with polynomial-time extraction of both Skolem and Herbrand functions. If it did, SynQBF's published optimality theorem would already imply polynomial simulation by SynQBF.
reverse_direction_no_redundant_work.current_v1_1_status: Frozen V1.1 is not yet established as a sound/complete QBF proof system and does not currently provide a full Herbrand-extraction theorem for arbitrary prenex QBF. Therefore Theorem 4.14 cannot yet be invoked as a completed translation result.
reverse_direction_no_redundant_work.immediate_question: Which precise additional properties would make the existing V1.1 interface qualify for the premises of Theorem 4.14, and can they be established without changing the frozen scientific claims?

first_theory_target.name: LOCALLY_CERTIFIED_SYNQBF_FRAGMENT_TO_V1_1
first_theory_target.question: Identify the largest useful SynQBF fragment whose Definition-4.3 proof obligations can be translated into frozen V1.1 local certificates with polynomial proof-size and translation-time overhead.
